shade.rule: Draw <part>-shade at the lit sprite position + (2,3) in world space, below the lit sprite and above everything drawn earlier. Rotate and scale the shade sprite with the part, but never rotate the (2,3) offset. Inside a rotated container, add the offset in world space too (or counter-rotate it by the container angle). Parts without a -shade file cast none. File coordinates: each sprite file has viewBox = bbox, so its top-left sits at bbox[0],bbox[1] of the character frame; pivots are in frame coordinates.

units: Same units as the characters (Teo is 197 tall): draw the machine and the characters at one scale. Ground line y = 420 (frame height 424 leaves room for the +3 shade), body spans x 20..340, the crank reaches x 395.

door.rule: Cuc Cu root (80,181 in its frame) sits at door.perch when out, at 0.8 of the machine scale. While inside, clip it to door.hole and draw it between machine-door and the leaves; once out, draw it above the whole machine. Open leaves: scaleX 0.22 of machine-door-l / machine-door-r about their pivots (the hinge edges); shade sprite scales the same way and keeps its +(2,3) offset.

needle.rule: Rotate machine-needle about its pivot. Stuck = parked at the stuck angle with machine-fx-stuck shown; shake it a few degrees around that angle.

screen.note: The coffee stain sits here; machine-stain is the same 10 x 12 cell grid as bg/ch1-minigame at pitch 10.

crank.rule: Rotate machine-crank about its pivot; the arm is 53 long, so a full turn stays inside the frame.
